remarks: Beautifully renovated 3 bedroom 1.5 bathroom with master bedroom having personal patio space perfect for relaxing. New appliances new hardwood floors and new bathrooms. New windows. Three floor Townhouse apartment in sought after private street in Norton Heights. Minutes away from hiking, shops, train station and downtown. Perfect for families or working professionals. Great school district   A spacious basement which could be used as a 4th bedroom if needed is included.  Washer and dryer in unit. Spacious garage provides ample space for all your hobbies and tools. Additionally full private back and side yard to have endless BBQs and get together.   Plenty of off street parking available
